import sys
from itertools import permutations

def consume(a, b, i):
    first = (i + 1) % 3
    second = i
    if b[i] > a[first]:
        b[i] -= a[first]
        a[first] = 0
        if b[i] > a[second]:
            b[i] -= a[second]
            a[second] = 0
        else:
            a[second] -= b[i]
            b[i] = 0
    else:
        a[first] -= b[i]
        b[i] = 0

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)  # not used
    a = [next(it), next(it), next(it)]
    b = [next(it), next(it), next(it)]

    max_val = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])

    min_ans = float('inf')
    for order in permutations([0, 1, 2]):
        ac = a[:]
        bc = b[:]
        for idx in order:
            consume(ac, bc, idx)
        min_ans = min(min_ans, sum(ac))

    print(f"{min_ans} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
